in_marathi.name: Parvesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parvesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parvesh is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Bringer of God'. This name is deeply rooted in Hinduism and carries the themes of strength, power, and leadership. It is believed that those named Parvesh are blessed with the courage and determination of a warrior, and are often destined to lead others.
